title: Candy Portal Demon
description: A massive blue horned demon emerges from a dark tunnel inscribed with the words 'LOST SOULS WORLD' and 'LAND OF WERM', reaching toward two kneeling girls holding hands in a colorful pool. To the right, a joyful girl in a pink tutu and roller skates runs toward a vibrant candy land filled with giant lollipops, gumdrops, and swirling rainbow patterns.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a giant blue demonic creature with horns emerging from a dark stone tunnel covered in dripping graffiti that reads LOST SOULS WORLD and LAND OF WERM. In the foreground two girls in tattered dresses with flower crowns kneel holding hands inside a glowing rainbow spiral pool. To the right a laughing girl in a colorful tutu, red gloves and roller skates runs toward a bright candy wonderland filled with giant swirling lollipops, gumdrops, and psychedelic mushrooms. Whimsical dark fairytale style.
